# Gymnopédie for the Grasses

the bunny-tails sway in the wind  
an interlude of air and sun and earth  
uncrafted - propelled by gusts of breeze  
each seed pod dances in its own rhythm, every passion unique.  
never still or cracked,  
they bow reverently to the ground where they are anchored  
to once more reach in port de bras toward the sun  
tireless and unceasing  
like the Sufi Dervish  
in his unity with Allah  
dance, dance, dance…  
for this - for now  
Fanã
